output.summary: A palm-like cycad endemic to eastern Australia, pineapple zamia produces some of the largest cycad cones and has crowns of long, glossy, dark-green leaves. All parts are toxic to humans, especially the seeds, which can cause severe illness if eaten.
output.edibilityNote: All parts are toxic to humans, especially the seeds; ingestion can cause severe digestive symptoms, liver damage and muscular paralysis.
